column4: 2.1: 2;1 1;guṇaśabdaḥ saṁjñātvena vidhīyate pratyekam adeṅāṁ taparakaraṇaṁ tv iha sarvārtham |;
3.1: 3;1 3;vṛddhiguṇau svasaṁjñayā śiṣyamāṇau ikaḥ eva sthāne vakṣyati sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ aṅgasya guṇa iti |;
3.1: 3;1 13;guṇavṛddhī svasaṁjñayā vidhīyete tatra ikaḥ iti kiṁ kṛtaṁ bhavati dvitīyayā ṣaṣṭhī prādurbhāvyate |;
3.1: 3;1 17;ikaḥ iti kim āt sandhyakṣaravyañjanānāṁ mā bhūt |;
3.1: 3;1 21;punar guṇavṛddhigrahaṇaṁ svasaṁjñayā vidhāne iha mā bhūt dyauḥ panthāḥ saḥ imam iti ||;
4.1: 4;1 1;dhātvekadeśo dhātuḥ tasya lopo yasmin ārdhadhātuke tad loluvaḥ |;
4.1: 4;1 4;lolūyādibhyo yaṅantebhyaḥ pacādyaci vihite yaṅo .ci ca iti dhātugrahaṇaṁ kim lūñ lavitā |;
4.1: 4;1 9;ārdhadhātuke iti kim tridhā baddho vṛṣabho roravīti iti |;
7.1: 7;1 1;bhinnajātīyair ajbhir avyavahitaḥ śliṣṭoccāritā halaḥ samudāyaḥ sañjñī |;
7.1: 7;1 3;tena dvayor bahūnāṁ ca saṁyogasañjñā siddhā bhavati |;
7.1: 7;1 9;tilān stry āvapati iti nasatarayāḥ natasatarayā vā |;
7.1: 7;1 10;halaḥ iti kim titaucchatram saṁyogāntasya lopaḥ iti lopaḥ anantarāḥ iti kim pacati panasam skoḥ saṁyogādyor ante ca saṁyogapradeśāḥ saṁyogāntasya lopaḥ ity evamādayaḥ ||;

9.1: 9;1 4;tulya āsye prayatno yasya varṇasya yena varṇena saha sa catvāra ābhyantarāḥ prayatnāḥ savarṇasaṁjñāyām a a a iti trayo .kārā udāttānudāttasvaritāḥ pratyekaṁ tathā ivarṇaḥ tathā uvarṇaḥ tathā ṛvarṇaḥ |;
9.1: 9;1 5;L.varṇasya dīrghā na santi taṁ dvādaśabhedam ācakṣate |;
9.1: 9;1 6;saṁdhyakṣarāṇāṁ hrasvā na santi tāny api antaḥsthā dviprabhedāḥ rephavarjitā yavalāḥ sānunāsikā rephoṣmaṇāṁ savarṇā na santi |;

9.1: 9;1 10;āsyagrahaṇaṁ kim kacaṭatapānāṁ bhinnasthānānāṁ kiṁ ca syāt tarptā tarptum ity atra jharojhari savarṇe iti prayatnagrahaṇaṁ kim icuyaśānāṁ tulyasthānānāṁ kiṁ ca syāt aruś cyotati ity atra jharojhari savarṇe iti ṛkāraṝkārayoḥ savarṇasañjñā vaktavyā |;
9.1: 9;1 13;ubhayoḥ ṛvarṇasya ṝvarṇasya cāntaratamaḥ savarṇo dīrgho savarṇapradeśāḥ akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ ity evamādayaḥ ||;
11.1: 11;1 1;īt ūt et ityevamantaṁ dvivacanaṁ śabdarūpaṁ agnī iti |;
11.1: 11;1 5;īd ūd et iti kim vṛkṣāv atra |;
11.1: 11;1 10;pragṛhyapradeśāḥ plutapragṛhyā aci nityam ity īdādīnāṁ pragṛhyatve maṇīvādīnāṁ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ maṇīvoṣṭrasya lambete priyau vatsatarau mama |;
12.1: 12;1 1;adasaḥ sambandhī yo makāras tasmāt pare īdūdetaḥ amī atra |;
14.1: 14;1 1;ekaśca asāvacca ekāc nipāto ya ekāc āṅvarjitaḥ sa a apehi |;
14.1: 14;1 8;ekāc iti kim pra agnaye vācam īraya |;
16.1: 16;1 2;sambuddhinimitto ya okāraḥ sa śākalyasya ācāryasya vāyo iti vāyaviti |;
16.1: 16;1 7;anārṣe iti kim etā gā brahmabandhav ity abravīt ||;
17.1: 17;1 2;uñaḥ pragṛhyasañjñā bhavati itau śākalyasya ācāryasya śākalyasya iti vibhāṣārtham |;
18.1: 18;1 2;uñaḥ itāvanārṣe ūṁ ity ayam ādeśo bhavati dīrgho śākalyasya grahaṇaṁ vibhāṣārtham iha apy anuvartate |;
18.1: 18;1 3;tena trīṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti u iti v iti ūṁ iti ||;
19.1: 19;1 2;īdantam ūdantaṁ ca śabdarūpaṁ saptamyarthe adhyasyāṁ māmakī tanū |;
19.1: 19;1 3;māmakyāṁ tanvām iti prāpte māmakyāṁ māmakī iti somo gaurī adhi śritaḥ |;
19.1: 19;1 4;īdūtau iti kim priyaḥ sūrye priyo agnā bhavāti |;
19.1: 19;1 6;saptamīgrahaṇaṁ kim dhītī matī suṣṭutī dhītyā matyā arthagrahaṇaṁ kim vāpyaśvaḥ |;
19.1: 19;3 2;jñāpakaṁ syāt tadantatve mā vā pūrvapadasya bhūt ||;
23.1: 23;1 1;bahu gaṇa vatu ity ete saṅkhyāsañjñā bhavanti |;
23.1: 23;1 18;bahugaṇaśabdayor vaipulye saṅghe ca vartamānayor iha bhūryādīnāṁ nivṛttyarthaṁ saṅkhyāsañjñā vidhīyate |;
23.1: 23;1 20;ardhaṁ pañcamaṁ yeṣām iti bahuvrīhau kṛte taddhitārtheti samāsaḥ |;
23.1: 23;1 21;tatra diksaṅkhye sañjñāyām ity anuvṛttes tataḥ adhyardhapūrvadvigor lugasañjñāyām iti luk |;
24.1: 24;1 2;ṣakārāntā nakārāntā ca yā saṅkhyā sā ṣaṭsañjñā bhavati |;
26.1: 26;1 1;ktaś ca ktavatuś ca ktaktavatū pratyayau niṣṭhāsañjñau kṛtaḥ |;
27.1: 27;1 1;sarvaśabdaḥ ādir yeṣāṁ tānīmāni sarvādīni sarvaḥ sarvau sarve |;
27.1: 27;1 15;ubhaśabdasya sarvanāmatve prayojanam sarvanāmnas ubhābhyāṁ hetubhyāṁ vasati ubhayoḥ hetvoḥ vasati |;
27.1: 27;1 34;tva tvat iti dvāv api ca anudāttau iti smaranti |;
27.1: 27;1 39;kathaṁ yathāsaṅkhyam anudeśaḥ samānām same deśe samasya sarvaśabdaparyāyasya sarvanāmasaṁjñeṣyate na sima simasmai |;
27.1: 27;1 42;tyad tad yad etad idam adas eka dvi yuṣmad |;
31.1: 31;1 1;dvandve ca samāse sarvādīni sarvanāmasañjñāni na pūrvāparāṇām |;
33.1: 33;1 12;tatra nema iti sarvādiṣu paṭhyate tasya prāpte vibhāṣā ubhayaśabdasya tayappratyayāntasya gaṇe pāṭhān nityā kākacoryathāyogaṁ vṛttiḥ ||;
34.1: 34;1 1;pūrva parāvaradakṣiṇottarāparādhara ityeṣāṁ gaṇe pāṭhāt pūrvādīni vibhāṣā jasi sarvanāmasañjñāni bhavanti svābhidheyāpekṣāvadhiniyamo vyavasthā |;
35.1: 35;1 1;atra api nityā sarvanāmasañjñā prāptā jasi vibhāṣyate |;
35.1: 35;1 2;svam ity etacchabdarūpaṁ jasi vibhāṣā sarvanāmasañjñaṁ sve putrāḥ svāḥ putrāḥ |;
35.1: 35;1 5;jñātipratiṣedhaḥ iti kim dhūmāyanta iva aśliṣṭāḥ prajvalanti ulmukāni iva me .mī svā jñātayo bharatarṣabha ||;
35.1: 35;2 1;adhanākhyāyām iti kim prabhūtāḥ svā na dīyante prabhūtāni dhanāni ity arthaḥ ||;
36.1: 36;1 1;atra api pūrveṇa nityā sarvanāmasañjñā prāptā sā jasi antaram ity etacchabdarūpaṁ vibhāṣā jasi antare gṛhāḥ antarāḥ gṛhāḥ |;
36.1: 36;1 5;bahiryogopasaṁvyānayoḥ iti kim anayoḥ grāmayor antare tasmin antare śītāny udakāni |;
36.1: 36;1 10;vibhāṣāprakaraṇe tīyasya vā ṅitsu sarvanāmasañjñā ity dvitīyasmai dvitīyāya |;
37.1: 37;1 4;sanutar uccais nīcais śanais ṛdhak ārāt ṛte yugapat pṛthak hyas śvas divā rātrau sāyam ciram manāk īṣat joṣam tūṣṇīm vatvadantam avyayasañjñaṁ bhavati |;
37.1: 37;1 7;san sanāt sanat tiras ete ādyudāttāḥ paṭhyante |;

37.1: 37;1 9;antareṇa jyok kam śam sanā sahasā vinā nānā svasti svadhā ktvātosuṅkasunaḥ kṛnmakārāntaḥ sandhyakṣarāntaḥ purā mitho mithas prabāhukam āryahalam abhīkṣṇam nipātā vakṣyante prāgrīśvarān nipātāḥ iti |;
37.1: 37;1 10;ca vā ha aha eva evam ityādayaḥ |;
39.1: 39;1 1;kṛd yo makārāntaḥ ejantaś ca tadantaṁ śabdarūpam svāduṅkāraṁ bhuṅkte |;
39.1: 39;1 8;vakṣe iti vaceḥ tumarthe sesenase iti sepratyaye kutve ṣatve eṣe iti iṇaḥ sepratyaye guṇe ṣatve ca kṛte rūpam |;
39.1: 39;1 10;dṛśe iti dṛśeḥ kenpratyayo nipātyate dṛśe vikhye ca iti |;
39.1: 39;1 12;iha mā bhūt ādhaye cikīrṣave kumbhakārebhyaḥ iti ||;
40.1: 40;1 1;ktvā tosun kasun ity evamantaṁ śabdarūpam kṛtvā |;
40.1: 40;1 5;bhāvalakṣaṇe stheṇkṛñvadi iti iṇaḥ kṛñaś ca tosun kasun sṛpitṛdoḥ kasun |;
43.1: 43;1 1;suṭ iti pañca vacanāni sarvanāmasthānasañjñāni bhavanti napuṁsake na vidhiḥ na pratiṣedhaḥ |;
43.1: 43;1 2;tena jasaḥ śeḥ sarvanāmasthānasañjñā pūrveṇa bhavaty eva rājā rājānau rājānaḥ |;
44.1: 44;1 5;tatra pratiṣedhena samīkṛte viṣaye paścād vikalpaḥ ubhayatravibhāṣāḥ prayojayanti |;
47: 45;1 3;acāṁ saṁniviṣṭānām antyād acaḥ paro mid bhavati |;
